rics.meaning: Business Conditions, 6 Months Hence — sub-index of BI Consumer Survey capturing forward-looking business-conditions assessment.
rics.how_to_use: Forward-looking sub-component. Track alongside CEI (aIDCONCE) for broader expectations read.

rics.meaning: Buying Durable Goods Conditions, Present — sub-index measuring whether households view current conditions as appropriate for big-ticket purchases.
rics.how_to_use: Leading indicator of durable-goods spending (autos, appliances, furniture). Falls during high-inflation or rate-hike periods.

rics.description: Consumer Confidence Index - Actual, Index, IDR
rics.meaning: Consumer Confidence Index — Reuters poll-anchored 'actual' release. Same conceptual measure as aIDCONCF.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check series. Reuters polls economists ahead of the BI release; the 'actual' is set when BI publishes.

rics.meaning: Consumer Confidence Index (CCI) — Bank Indonesia monthly Survey of Consumer Confidence (SK). Composite of Current Conditions Index (CCI-Present) and Consumer Expectations Index (CEI). Released first week of each month.
rics.how_to_use: Most-watched Indonesia consumer-sentiment gauge. Above 100 = optimistic, below 100 = pessimistic. Indonesia consumer confidence has been resilient: typically 110-130. Sharp drops below 100 (1998, 2008, 2020) signal economic crisis. Sub-indices: business conditions, employment, income — track separately.

rics.meaning: Consumer Expectations Index (CEI / IEK) — forward-looking sub-component of BI's consumer confidence survey. Captures households' 6-month outlook on income, employment, and business conditions.
rics.how_to_use: Leads household consumption growth by 1-2 quarters. Sub-100 readings sustained for 3+ months signal upcoming consumption slowdown. Pair with Present Conditions index (aIDCONCFPT) — when expectations diverge below current conditions, consumer cycle is rolling over.

rics.meaning: Present Conditions Index (IKE) — sub-component of BI's consumer confidence survey assessing current economic conditions, employment, and major-purchase appropriateness.
rics.how_to_use: Coincides with current consumption activity (vs CEI which leads). Pairs with retail sales, vehicle sales for current-state cross-check. Higher than expectations = late-cycle pattern; lower = early-cycle.

rics.meaning: Current Incomes, Present — sub-index measuring household current-income perceptions.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with income expectations (aIDCSINC6MN). Divergence (current high, expectations low) signals income-cycle peak.

rics.meaning: Employment Conditions, Present — sub-index assessing current labor-market perceptions.
rics.how_to_use: Track for current labor-market health from household side. Coincides with unemployment trends.

rics.meaning: Employment, 6 Months Hence — household forward-looking employment-prospects sub-index.
rics.how_to_use: Leading labor-market indicator. Drops below current-conditions sub-index signal upcoming labor-market deterioration.

rics.meaning: Income Expectations, 6 Months Hence — sub-index of BI Consumer Survey capturing forward-looking household income optimism.
rics.how_to_use: Leading indicator for consumer spending. When income expectations fall while current incomes hold steady, households start saving more — consumption decelerates 1-2 quarters later. Diverges sharply from current-incomes (aIDCSCRICMP) at cycle turning points.

rics.description: Price expectations for next 6 mos., overall prices
rics.meaning: Price Expectations for Next 6 Months, Overall — household 6-month-ahead price expectation index from BI's Consumer Survey.
rics.how_to_use: Slightly longer horizon than aIDCSGENPR6. Both should track each other; divergence signals near vs medium-term inflation worry. Useful as a cross-check for BI's quarterly inflation forecasts published in the Monetary Policy Report.

rics.meaning: Price Expectations, General, 3 months hence — household inflation expectation sub-index from BI's Consumer Survey. Captures anticipated overall price changes.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia's inflation expectations are sticky around BI's target band (1.5-3.5% since 2024). Sharp jumps signal expectation un-anchoring — concerning for BI policy. Pair with aIDPREXFR6M (6-month version) for short vs medium horizon read.

rics.description: LSEG / Ipsos Primary Consumer Sentiment Index (CSI)
rics.meaning: LSEG/Ipsos Primary Consumer Sentiment Index (CSI) for Indonesia — alternative consumer-sentiment gauge from Ipsos surveys.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against BI's Consumer Confidence Index (aIDCONCF). Smaller-sample but good for triangulation.

rics.description: LSEG / Ipsos Primary Consumer Sentiment Index (PCSI)
rics.meaning: LSEG/Ipsos Primary Consumer Sentiment Index (PCSI) — companion to aIDCCIPSOR.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check. Use either for tertiary consumer-sentiment read.
